title: Old Train
description: Old train in the middle of a redwood forest in Felton, California.Roaring Camp Railroads is a heritage railroad that operates in the Santa Cruz Mountains, offering scenic train rides through the redwoods. The train is a historic steam locomotive that has been restored and maintained to provide visitors with an authentic experience of traveling through the forest as it was in the early 20th century.

description: A French Swan eating grass captured in the gardens of the Château de Versailles, France. Notice how the swan is cut off; this was intentional since there was a fence blocking the way. The photo was taken during a school trip to France in 2025.

title: Western Brook Pond
description: Captured from a boat departing the fjord. The combination of calm water, rugged rock faces, and expansive sky highlights the immense scale and beauty of Newfoundland's glacier-carved landscape. Captured on trip to Nova Scotia and Newfoundland in 2022.
